comparator.sourceNotes: Exact Dutch full-time ordinary BA Religion, Politics and Society, specialisation of Religiewetenschappen CROHO50902 at Radboud. Registry1016O6659/1016O6837 and OER1015O6480/1015O9561 differ administratively; no code equivalence asserted. Degree identity is established by institution/title/CROHO/language/180EC. Adopted2026–27 annual framework and2025+ exit terms:120required+30restricted complete modules+30genuineopen=180EC,60peryear. One care module inB2 and one climate module inB3 selected independently ofUCRfit. Six5ECmodule components explicitly represented; alternative modules not additive. No shortened/IPS-Arabic/parttime/master conflation or future entrant timetable promise. RADArNL0required; equivalent university language-test exemption possible. Workgroup/practicum attendance80percent. Normalfulltime BSA44EC, late/reentry/deferred norms60EC in incorporated appendix, whose2023–24 footer is distinguished from current curriculum. PPO2 B2 builds onB1/PPO1 methods, yearlong research with individualpaper in collectiveproject. PPO3 B3 disciplinary knowledge, professional profile/portfolio/scientificfieldproject. Finalwork B3/AcademicSkills, compulsoryworkshop, approvedquestion and individualmethodologicalresearch under workshop/content supervision, complete by secondsemester; no replacement/exemption. Genuine open courses cannot overlap programme content or be masterlevel; external/nonfaculty electives and internship need applicable approval. Internship atmost15EC, nominalprogress, self-found placement and coordinator supervision/approval. OER care-code RTBA/RTIBA print variants do not establish a new course or extra credits; named component governs.

exception.reason: The selected UCR courses offer genuine philosophy, myth, religious material/visual heritage, legal and social analysis, media/rhetoric and qualitative research. Neither complete proposal sustains comparative study of Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism and Buddhism, sacred texts, lived religion, religious change and religion-specific anthropological/sociological methods. General politics or media study does not become study of religion merely by choosing that application; myth and religious art contribute partially without supplying the missing disciplinary sequence. Bounded recombination preserves those strengths but cannot build a sufficiently close complete response.

audience.programmeDescription: Radboud Religion, Politics and Society studies religious traditions, texts, practices and contemporary social questions. Comparative study of religions connects with anthropology, sociology, philosophy and research on power, migration, media and cultural change.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers useful philosophy, myth, cultural heritage, politics and media study. These contributions do not build the sustained comparative study of religious traditions and religion-specific research at the centre of this degree. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a sufficiently close alternative.

curriculum.routeLabel: Ordinary full-time bachelor; Religion and Care plus Worldviews, Nature and Climate modules
curriculum.limitation: The 180 EC framework includes 120 EC of required study, two complete 15 EC modules and 30 EC of free choice. Each selected module has three 5 EC courses. Research includes a supervised project and a 10 EC individual final work. RADAr-NL carries no credits; an equivalent university test can support exemption. The usual first-year study-advice threshold is 44 EC. External electives and internships need applicable approval; professional careers may require further qualifications.
